title: Geofence Safe-Return Lag
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:geofence zone_name=* exit_epoch=* return_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((return_epoch-exit_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by zone_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures safe-return lag by zone for wandering episodes.
value: Lag tracking shows which zone create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside wandering episodes.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `safe-return lag` on `care:geofence` events and aggregate them by `zone_name`.
visualization: Table of zone with average and worst safe-return lag.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how long things take for each zone so you can see where wandering episodes slows down.
